# claude-kit

> Themes, status line widgets and mini apps for Claude Code on macOS. A theme is a folder of data that the kit turns into a status line, a welcome card, Claude Code colors, a patched Monaco font with a mascot glyph, and an iTerm2 profile. Every change is recorded and can be undone with `kit uninstall`.

Agents should read AGENTS.md first. It lists the non-interactive commands, the repository map, the checks and the rules.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, repository map, verification and rules for agents
- [README.md](README.md): what the kit does and how to install it
